firmware-tasks.title: Four tasks over one HAL
firmware-tasks.alt: Task diagram of the Vortex V1 firmware: the ESP-IDF main task runs app_main and then the supervisor loop; it starts the VortexSys orchestrator, which starts the LedDemo (WS2812 test) thread and, optionally, the CANopen device task (co_svc, serving CoNode); all of them use the Vortex HAL, which drives the TMC9660, AS5047U, BNO08x, PCAL95555, the CAN transceiver and the WS2812 LED.
firmware-tasks.description: From top to bottom. The ESP-IDF main task runs app_main, which starts the VortexSys orchestrator task and waits for its boot table, then becomes the supervisor loop. VortexSys brings up the HAL, starts the LedDemo thread (WS2812TestThread) and, when menuconfig selects the CANopen device, the co_svc task that serves CoNode (CANopenNode over the generated object dictionary, on the TWAI port). Every task reaches the hardware through the Vortex HAL singleton, which owns the managers, the hf-core handlers and the chip drivers. Stack sizes and priorities are the constants in the sources listed below.
